statement: Any Phase 4 DiDQube consumer (Factor, Aegis, CTP, DCIR, Standing, Registry/Horizen) that needs to answer 'is this subject's constitutional identity established' MUST resolve that question through services/identity/didQubeResolver.ts::resolveDiDQube, never by reading agent_root_identity/kybe_identity/root_identity tables directly and treating a raw anchor row's mere existence as sufficient. A raw anchor row proves the ANCHOR exists; it does not prove the anchor is bound into its DiDQube constitutional container, and a consumer that skips the resolver has no way to distinguish 'genuinely resolved' from 'anchor exists but container is unbound/conflicted/ambiguous'. Where a consumer has legitimate cause to complete a missing binding for an anchor it just created or is actively establishing (never for an arbitrary anchor it merely discovered), it MUST do so through the one shared, idempotent write path (services/identity/didQubeResolver.ts::ensureAgentDiDQubeBinding for agents; human bindings arise from kybe_identity's own process) — never a duplicate INSERT into didqubes/agent_didqubes/human_didqubes. A consumer whose progression depends on this fact (prepare-gating, approval-gating, or execution-gating per the execution plan's own classification, ruling #8) must report the resolver's actual state honestly (established/missing/blocked/unreadable) and never silently upgrade an unresolved/conflicted result into an assumed-resolved one.
classification: A parallel-implementation-avoidance invariant (inv.engineering.036/037's family) specific to the DiDQube Phase 4 migration sequence: the resolver (Phase 2) and the supertype tables (Phase 1) were built and verified before any consumer existed, so every Phase 4 consumer migration independently faces the same temptation to keep its own pre-existing raw-table identity walk rather than adopting the resolver — Factor's own resolveAgentShellLeg is the first documented instance of exactly that temptation, caught only because this migration was explicitly scoped to replace it.

canaries.assertion: Factor's didqubeContainer leg calls resolveDiDQube (never treats a bare agent_root_identity row as sufficient), gates progression on its actual resolution state (unresolved/conflicted both block further advancement in the same call), and completes a missing binding ONLY via ensureAgentDiDQubeBinding, never a direct insert.

createAssessment's optional subjectIdentity resolves through resolveDiDQube (never a raw agent_root_identity read treated as sufficient); an unresolved/absent identity leaves the four subject_didqube_*/snapshot fields null and still creates the assessment (additive, never blocking); a resolved identity populates all fields and the snapshot is untouched by later ratification.

occurrences.defect: Treated a bare agent_root_identity row (found via findAgentRootIdentityBySlug) as sufficient proof the agent's constitutional identity was established, with no check against the canonical DiDQube resolver at all.

No mechanism existed for Aegis to record which constitutional identity an assessment's subject corresponded to at all -- subject_ref (a factor_case/token_launch id) never named a resolvable anchor, and nothing filled that gap through the canonical resolver until this migration.

notes: Promoted candidate -> validated (2 occurrences: Factor, Aegis) per the ladder's own mechanical criteria (>=2 recorded occurrences) — an agent may reach `validated` (AGENT_MAX_STAGE) but never ratified/canonical, which require a named operator act. Expected to gain further occurrences as CTP/DCIR/Standing/Registry-Horizen are each migrated in their own vertical commits — each should reference this same candidate rather than minting a parallel one, per inv.engineering.036/037.

Live-verified (2026-09-07, Aigent Z project bsjhfvctmduxhohtllly): all 19 existing agent_root_identity rows already carry an agent_didqubes binding as of the Factor migration — there is no current data gap this invariant is protecting against, only a future one (a new anchor created through a path that never calls ensureAgentDiDQubeBinding).
